title: A considered product launch

creativeDirection.objective: Introduce a premium everyday object by communicating considered design and tactile quality.
creativeDirection.audience: Design-conscious adults discovering the product for the first time.
creativeDirection.concept: A sequence of precise material and detail reveals builds toward one confident hero frame.

visualSystem.typography: Restrained grotesk sans-serif with large editorial headlines.
visualSystem.composition: Asymmetric product framing with deliberate negative space for short copy.
visualSystem.lighting: Soft directional key with controlled edge highlights and deep but readable shadows.
visualSystem.textureAndMaterials: Brushed metal, matte polymer and fine machined details.

creativeDirection.motionLanguage: Slow controlled macro pushes, one lateral orbit, purposeful match cuts and a still final hero shot.
creativeDirection.soundDirection: Minimal original electronic pulse, subtle tactile foley and one restrained final impact.
assumptions: The product is fictional for this example; no real specifications are claimed.
rightsAndFactualConstraints: Use original generated visuals and audio or assets with documented reuse rights.

shots.purpose: Hook the viewer with tactile detail.
shots.visual: An extreme macro of a brushed metal edge catches a narrow moving highlight; the full product remains partly concealed.
shots.framing: Extreme macro, diagonal crop, shallow depth of field.
shots.cameraMovement: Slow controlled push-in with a short focus reveal.
shots.transition: Begin from near-black; cut on the highlight movement.
shots.audio: A soft mechanical texture enters before the music pulse.
shots.action: The camera advances toward the brushed metal edge while a narrow highlight travels across it; the full object stays concealed.
shots.visualProgression: Start: nearly black with only a sliver of metal. Development: the highlight sweeps and reveals texture. End: the edge becomes a visual bridge to the product silhouette.

shots.purpose: Reveal the overall silhouette and material language.
shots.visual: The product rotates through a clean three-quarter view against a restrained studio background; highlights travel across the surface.
shots.framing: Medium product shot, subject right of centre with negative space on the left.
shots.cameraMovement: Smooth short orbit with a gentle dolly-out.
shots.transition: Match cut from the moving highlight into the product edge.
shots.audio: Music opens slightly; a subtle whoosh follows the camera move.
shots.action: The headphones rotate into a three-quarter view as highlights travel across the headband and earcups.
shots.visualProgression: Start: the object is only partially visible. Development: the orbit reveals the full silhouette and material. End: the product settles into a clear three-quarter composition.

shots.visual: A close-up isolates a control or seam; a precise light sweep reveals its finish without adding fictional labels.
shots.framing: Tight close-up, shallow angle, asymmetric crop.
shots.cameraMovement: Short lateral slider move, then hold.
shots.audio: Quiet tactile click; music ducks briefly to make it audible.
shots.action: A close-up isolates a control or seam while a light sweep exposes its finish.
shots.visualProgression: Start: enter on a cropped, ambiguous detail. Development: the lateral camera move and light sweep reveal the construction. End: hold on the readable detail.

shots.purpose: Resolve the story with a clear, memorable product frame.
shots.visual: The complete product settles into a balanced hero composition; the background falls away and the brand lockup appears.
shots.framing: Wide hero shot, product centred slightly right, generous safe-area typography.
shots.cameraMovement: A final gentle push that eases to a complete stop.
shots.transition: Dissolve into the final lockup; hold to the end.
shots.audio: Music resolves; one restrained low-frequency impact and a clean tail.
shots.action: The complete product settles into the hero composition and the brand lockup appears.
shots.visualProgression: Start: product is still moving into frame. Development: it settles as the background simplifies. End: the lockup and product hold in a clean final frame.

acceptanceCriteria: The product silhouette is clearly revealed by the end of the second shot.
The visual identity remains consistent across macro, medium and hero shots.
No two adjacent shots use the same framing scale and camera movement.
All on-screen copy is readable and remains inside title-safe areas.
The soundtrack supports the edit without masking tactile effects.
The final hero composition holds long enough to read and remember.

renderStrategy.rationale: The plan calls for multi-shot 3D product macro work, a bespoke product reveal and a camera-driven hero shot. No currently registered composition is a general product renderer.
renderStrategy.fallback: Implement and register ProductRevealFilm before rendering. Do not substitute the ProjectVideo fixed layout without revising the creative plan.
